Show the idea visually: sound waves from a speaker turning into accurate text, two streams merging into one, a sense of things clicking into place. Do not try to write a title or any sentences.

any text that appears is real, correctly spelled words; no pseudo-text or garbled glyphs
notes: Descriptive prompt with no exact strings, no title and no diagram elements: ratings only, no validation ticks. structure_checks are a checklist for the ratings.
